experiment: Perfect numbers finite certificate (Gap Ledger G27)

euler_form.form: n = q^a * m^2, q prime, q = a = 1 (mod 4), m odd

honest_wall: Finite search only: no odd perfect number exists up to the search limit; the even perfect numbers are exactly those built from Mersenne primes (Euclid-Euler). Whether any odd perfect number exists at all is OPEN (best known if one exists: > 10^1500).
